module: Local WebSocket server (127.0.0.1:8088, name "nodestream") that broadcasts the player vehicle's structure live to an external client (3D viewer, debugging tool). The client can request: the initial node positions, the flexbody mapping data, starting/stopping the stream of current positions (every 0.1 s), or loading an extension. Other JSON messages are relayed to extensions via the onWebSocketHandlerMessage hook.
notes: Protocol: text messages; "ping" receives "pong"; otherwise JSON with a type field: loadExtension (extensionName), startNodeStream, stopNodeStream, getInitialNodePositions, getFlexbodyMappingData. Responses have type info, error, vehicleNodes, initialNodePositions or flexbodyMappingData.

Coordinates sent are converted to {x, z, -y} (vertical Y axis on the client side). Current positions (vehicleNodes) are those from getNodePosition, relative to the reference node; initial positions are offset by those of the reference node.
Security: any locally connected client can make the game load an arbitrary extension (loadExtension).
In getInitialNodePositions, if getRefNodeId() returns nil, refNodePos stays nil and indexing refNodePos.x would cause an error.
In broadcastVehicleNodes, refNodePos is computed but never used; the initialNodes field of the message stays an empty table.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called on load: creates (or retrieves) the WebSocket server via wsUtils.createOrGetWS on 127.0.0.1:8088.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Called on unload: destroys the WebSocket server (BNGWebWSServer.destroy).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: broadcasts node positions if the stream is active (0.1 s interval), handles client events (connection C, disconnection DC, data D), then updates the server.
